text.text: Accelerate upstream workflows and provide “connect from anywhere” availability to your high-value workers with the industry’s only unified scale-out storage architecture by using NetApp FAS8000 series storage systems. Adapt faster to changing upstream user application needs while achieving core IT requirements for data security, uptime, scalability, and mobility. Leverage data storage and management best practices established by NetApp and Schlumberger for applications such as the Petrel E&P software platform and others that rely on our most popular hybrid storage arrays purpose-built for business-critical workloads. These range from high-speed data access to massive data movement to multi-PB scale to leading flash integration.

text.text: NetApp disk shelves and storage media provide flexibility, reliability, and cross-platform leverage, plus storage efficiency. NetApp offers a range of storage media, from high-capacity to high-performing disk drives, plus self-encrypting drives and extreme performance options using solid state technology. The NetApp family of disk shelves delivers: Enterprise-class resiliency and availability Flexibility to use across FAS and V-Series storage systems Nondisruptive controller upgrades, protecting your investment Industry-leading storage efficiency with the NetApp Data ONTAP ® operating system
